//: A SEPARATE WORKER, SO A PREVIEW CANNOT REACH PRODUCTION TRAFFIC.
//name: Different script name from ocade-web on purpose. Deploying this can never overwrite the production Worker, and rolling it back is deleting something nothing points at.
name: ocade-web-preview
//workers_dev: TRUE here and FALSE in wrangler.json. This is the whole point: the preview needs a reachable URL and production must never have one outside its own domain.
//routes: Deliberately absent. No route means no request for ocade.in or www.ocade.in can ever arrive here, whatever is deployed.
